Backup and restore (IF-009: server/services/backupService.ts, backupSchemas.ts) do not carry questionnaire_sends. A restored backup forgets which companies were waiting for answers. Decide in Phase 7 whether the backup should include them. This unit did not touch the backup files.

Use createQuestionnaireRepository(prisma) from server/repositories/questionnaireRepository.ts. listAwaiting(companyId?) returns sends with answeredAt IS NULL, newest first. findClientSavedAtByDraft(draftId) returns Date or null for the timeline mark. draftId has no foreign key.
